texts.preamble: S Srinivas vs The State Of Ap on 3 July, 2025 N Aphc010321242025 In The High Court Of Andhra Pradesh I At Amaravati 0f (Special Original Jurisdiction) X om Thursday,The Third Day Of July Two Thousand And Twenty Five Present The Honourable Sri Justice Challa Gunaranjan Writ Petition No: 16234 Of 207^ Between: S. Srinivas, S/o. Surya Rao, aged about 60 years, Asst. Food Controller, Chittoor, Chittoor district ...Petitioner And 1. The State of Andhra Pradesh, Rep. by its Principal Secretary , Health, Medical and Family Welfare Department, Secretariat, Velagapudi, Amravati, Guntur District. 2. The Director, Directorate of Institute of Preventive Medicine Public Health Laboratories & Food (Health) Administration Andhra Pradesh, Gollapudi, Vijayawada. 3. The Director, Health & Family Welfare & Commissioner of Food Safety, Admin \(h], Apiic Towers, Plot No.l, 5*^ Floor, It Park , Mangalarigi, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh.
texts.facts: Petitioner is aggrieved by the action of the respondents in not considering the application dated 05.06.2025, which iIS a request for transfer in accordance with G.O.Ms.No.23 dated 15.05.2025. Petitioner is working as Assistant Food Controller at Chittor and is now aged 60 years due for superannuation within two years from now. Petitioner completed three years at the said station. As general transfers being affected, in terms of the same, petitioner made request for transfer to any of the stations as mentioned in the application.
